messages:
Anna: Quick sync — VendorX is asking to onboard 'Nimbus-3' into our marketplace. Two core asks from them: (1) confirm we can redistribute weights so marketplace/Dedicated/Private can use hosted copies, (2) permission to bundle the model with an HW partner's firmware for an edge appliance. Need legal + infra input before next Tue. I've asked VendorX for the license text.

Mohit: Do we know what license they intend to use? Apache/MIT/etc vs any NoDerivs/NonCommercial clauses? That will be the gating factor for redistribution.

Legal: Please share the exact license file. High level: permissive = likely OK; restrictive / custom language = need an addendum. If they want redistribution + commercial use we should get a signed redistribution addendum. Suggested minimal language: ```redistribution: sublicensable; commercial use permitted; conversions (quantization/format changes) allowed; attribution required``` — will draft.

Priya: For marketplace UX: we can do a hosted-first listing if vendor won't allow weight distribution. In that case we mark listing as "hosted-only" and disable Dedicated/Private install option. That reduces partner bundling options though.

Sara: From infra POV, hosting weights means object storage + access controls + copy-on-ingest for Dedicated. Also we need explicit conversion consent if we are allowed to produce quantized or optimised variants for performance. Ask them to permit automated conversion.

Jules: On the hardware bundling ask: our HW partners require a redistribution agreement signed by both vendor and partner. Also flagging export-control review if the model or training data has geo restrictions. I'll loop infra-security and partner-ops.

Legal: Draft checklist for VendorX: 1) license type + full text, 2) redistribution addendum (sublicense/derivative/quantization clarity), 3) co-marketing & announcement permission, 4) export compliance statement, 5) indemnity/warranty framing. I'll prepare a 1-page addendum template and share redline.

Anna: Timeline: Vendor suggested a joint announcement in ~4 weeks. Realistically addendum + partner signoff is ~2 weeks legal + partner time. Proposed plan: (A) ask VendorX for license + conversion consent today; (B) Sara/Jules estimate infra & partner work by EOD tomorrow; (C) Priya drafts marketplace copy for hosted-only variant in case vendor resists redistribution.

Mohit: Also confirm whether VendorX expects co-branded press and what the comms windows/dependencies are. If they want a joint press release we need marketing looped and dates locked early.

Priya: Draft listing copy uploaded: https://drive.redwood/vendornimbus3/draft (please comment). I'll include a "hosted-only" variant and a separate "hosted+distributed" variant copy. @Legal please add any required legal disclaimers.

Legal: I'll post the addendum template later today with redlines. If vendor is amenable we'll ask them to countersign and attach as an exhibit to the marketplace agreement.

ops-bot: reminder set: follow up with VendorX in 48 hours.

Anna: Action items summary: • Anna: ping VendorX for license + conversion consent (today). • Priya: marketplace copy (tomorrow). • Sara: infra/storage + conversion implications (EOD tomorrow). • Jules: partner redistribution + export check (EOD tomorrow). • Legal: draft addendum and checklist (today). If we have the license + consents in 48h we can decide hosted-only vs full redistribution and circle back to schedule a 20m sync. :+1:

Mohit: Thanks — adding marketing & comms to the loop once Legal confirms redistribution stance.

Anna: Cool. I'll update once I hear back from VendorX.
